test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - Quant (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A batsman has an average of 54 runs in 19 innings. How many runs should he score in the 20th innings to raise his average to 56?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New Average = 56

Increase in average = 56 − 54 = 2 runs

Total increase required for previous 19 innings = 19 × 2 = 38 runs

Runs required in 20th innings = New Average + Total Increase = 56 + 38 = 94

**∴ The correct answer is 94.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 19 innings = 54

Required average of 20 innings = 56

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total Runs ÷ Number of Innings

Total Runs = Average × Number of Innings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cea7ffe1bc30f0855b45490a10b722b364a6bb2dcc4b8276caa5bdc0cff5049a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs in 19 innings = 19 × 54 = 1026

⇒ Total runs in 20 innings = 20 × 56 = 1120

⇒ Runs in 20th innings = Total runs in 20 innings − Total runs in 19 innings

⇒ Runs in 20th innings = 1120 − 1026

⇒ Runs in 20th innings = 94

**∴ The correct answer is 94.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Change Property

If each observation is increased or decreased by a constant value 'k', the average also increases or decreases by 'k'.

New Entry Formula

New Value = Old Average + (Number of New Observations × Change in Average). This is useful for finding the value of a new person joining a group.

Weighted Average

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the count and x is the individual average.</p
